kbxe01.title: The 2 a.m. "u up?" draft
kbxe01.caption:
Your thumb at 2 a.m. is not your best advisor.
Write it in your notes, put the phone face down, and decide in daylight.

kbxe02.title: Found their hoodie in the laundry
kbxe02.caption: Found their hoodie and suddenly you're writing a novel? A hoodie text is fine. The "also, I miss you" part belongs with a friend.

kbxe03.title: Big news, wrong first call
kbxe03.caption: Good news and your first instinct is to tell them. Share the win where it gets cheered: the people who were there all year.

kbxe04.title: They liked your story
kbxe04.caption: One like, forty theories. A like says "I saw it" and that's all. Go to dinner. Save this for the next time your phone lights up.

kbxe05.title: The photo memory hit
kbxe05.caption: When the old photo pops up and it hurts. Missing a good day doesn't mean going back. Keep the memory, and tell a friend instead.

kbxe06.title: It's cold and you miss them
kbxe06.caption: Cold nights make everything feel like missing someone. Sometimes you miss being warm. Make the soup and share it with someone near.

kbxe07.title: The closure essay, draft twelve
kbxe07.caption: Twelve drafts in and the closure essay has footnotes. If you've already said it, a reply won't bring the peace. Read it out loud, then let it go.
